note: The wouterwall kit's adapter onto the material library (core/materials/PLAN.md). The host's ground layers (47-host-land.js): ground.steppe (the feather-grass steppe, the base, tinted by season), ground.needles (the larch's litter on the shaded slopes), ground.gravel (ground.gravel019: the gully floor, the brook's bed), rock.loess (the loess walls, the terraces' risers and the earth pillars, read from the side on the steep: KGROUND's triplanar sides), ground.terrace (ground.terrace.field: the terraced fields, furrows along the contour), ground.tundra and ground.lichen (ground.lichen.crust: the upper bench). The flora at W1 is the NW outer wall's, read in place with its own pack (build.py). The stations' slots (47: SITE.slots): rock.megabreccia (the crater's patchwork rock: the slump scarps, station 2; the scar and the megablocks, station 3; the box canyon's walls under the loess, station 4; and the stacks' mesh), ground.rubble (rock.rubble.sturzstrom: the runouts' deposit and the scarps' talus, stations 2-3). The kit's own species: organic.dusttower (the dust towers' bossed surface, on KSTACKS mounds), puya and puyaspike (card.puya: a rosette cell of the top row, the flower spike cut from the bottom rows). Run python3 tools/textures/pack.py biomes/wouterwall after any change, then python3 build.py. The terraces' crops (kits/crops, the wouterwall records, 2026-11-10; 50 and 60, station 1): crop.dustmillet (card.crop.grainhead's bushy panicle, greyscale, tinted by season), crop.redstem (card.crop.plume's red heads: Tartary buckwheat), crop.dust-lentil (card.crop.bean's low bushy row), crop.bench-garlic (card.crop.greens' strap leaves), crop.wallhemp (card.crop.nettle).
